title: [review] tx_queue.py:385: pop() does not signal reservat
description: The pop() method removes the front entry but never signals its reservation. If code calls push() with return_reservation=True, then later removes the entry via pop() instead of reserve()/complete(), the caller awaiting that reservation will hang forever. While documented in the docstring (lines 391-397), this API footgun could cause deadlocks if callers mix the two dequeue patterns.
